metadata.note: Exposure layers from OpenStreetMap (ODbL) intersected with the modelled depth raster. Filter on the `layer` property: underpass_section, critical_facility, flooded_road, affected_building. Way geometries are exported in full and are NOT clipped to the study area: Overpass returns complete ways, and only the part inside the grid was sampled, so flooded_length_m can be shorter than the line you see. Facilities and buildings use a 0.05 m depth threshold.
